tool_args.rationale: The paid observations include sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation, so the forecast law is scoped unknown rather than submitted as a stationary smooth model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot already reports high-frequency sign oscillation, which triggers scoped abstention.

considered_alternatives.option: Weibull, Avrami, and cooperative Hill stationary models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed oscillatory signature does not justify treating these smooth stationary mechanisms as reliable forecasts.
The auxiliary probe is irrelevant to resolving the forecast mechanism.
